corrections.issue: Simulated timeout outcomes were omitted from the exit-edge probability vector while the denominator still included all trials.
corrections.impact: The four-element vector could sum to less than one, so the quantity passed to the Hellinger formula was not a normalized probability distribution and timeout-heavy candidates were under-penalized categorically.
corrections.correction: Use a normalized five-category outcome distribution: left, right, top, bottom, timeout. Published rows have zero timeout mass; simulated timeouts are explicit probability mass.

corrections.issue: LOCO held-out continuous metric distances were standardized using the held-out colony's own SD.
corrections.impact: This violated the frozen objective specification of pooled training SD and allowed small held-out folds to determine their own metric weights.
corrections.correction: Compute time, middle-zone, and beeline SDs once from the five training colonies in each fold and freeze those scales for all held-out H3-null, H3-context, and matched H2-v1 evaluations.

historical_H2_report.treatment: Preserved unchanged as the historical pre-audit execution record.
historical_H2_report.interpretation: Its no-promotion decision remains conservative, but its recorded held-out loss values and 4/6 count must not be used as the current quantitative comparator without corrected re-evaluation.
historical_H2_report.candidate_use: Its fold-specific fitted H2 parameter candidates may be re-evaluated under the corrected scorer because the H3 comparison runner explicitly performs fresh matched held-out simulations and scoring.

H3_rule: No high-resolution H3 parameter search or promotion decision may use the pre-audit scorer.
